title: chore: setup scheduled release
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!
  Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request.
-->

**Summary**

This PR sets up scheduled release. And it additionally upgrades `ship.js` to the latest version and updated some configs due to the breaking changes from `ship.js`.

We can periodically release the newer version of the library. And I hope to get rid of unnecessary communication like:

> Can I release this today? Any blocker?

Instead, the pull request will be created automatically, and as reviewers, we can address any blocker in the pull request if there is any.

**Result**

Every Tuesday 09:00 UTC (11am Paris), `shipjs prepare` will run and create a release pull-request.
If there is a patch update and there is no `fix` commit, then it will skip.
